en: Vintage black-and-white panoramic view of a small town photographed from across an open field. A row of low wooden or stone houses with pitched roofs stretches across the horizon, with a church spire rising near the center and trees behind the settlement. The printed caption at the top reads "Oberpahlen. Totalansicht." and there is a handwritten addition above it. The corners show some wear, consistent with an old postcard.
